# osc-bridge — one named OSC surface for 963 synthesizers, drum machines and DAWs

> osc-bridge is an open-source (AGPL-3.0) OSC ↔ MIDI/SysEx bridge and MCP server written in Rust. Each of its 981 device drivers is a JSON file that names a device's CC, NRPN, SysEx parameters and drum sounds as OSC addresses (e.g. `/minilab3/pad/0/color 127 0 0`, `/drm1_mkiv/drum/kick 110`). The bridge translates both ways and exposes the catalogue to Claude and other AI assistants through MCP. Free, single binary for Linux, macOS and Windows.

This is the entry point for language models (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) reading about this project. Source: https://github.com/roomi-fields/osc-bridge — npm: `@roomi-fields/osc-bridge` — MCP registry: `io.github.roomi-fields/osc-bridge`.

Catalogue: 963 devices from 212 vendors. Each driver states its source: ✅ tested on the device (5), 📘 manufacturer documentation (3), 📡 software OSC API (7: Ableton Live via AbletonOSC, Bitwig, Reaper, Sonic Pi, SuperCollider, Pure Data, TouchDesigner, VCV Rack), 🎛️ Electra One community presets (588), 📦 MIDI Guide community data, CC BY-SA 4.0 (376). Most drivers are not yet tested on hardware.

Commands: `osc-bridge detect` (find connected devices with the MIDI Identity Request and match drivers), `run` (bridge one device; OSC on 127.0.0.1:7777; `--osc-client` for MIDI-in → OSC; `--ws-bind` for browser clients over WebSocket), `orchestrate` (several devices, inter-device routes), `backup` / `restore` (SysEx preset librarian, .syx files), `inspect`, `lint`, `osc-send`, `osc-listen`, `mcp`.

Hosted MCP server (no account): https://mcp.osc-bridge.roomi-fields.com/mcp — catalogue tools plus report_result (works / fails / partial, per firmware, with the device's Identity Reply) and get_trust (usage-verified, firmware-dependent, disputed…); every driver's trust at https://mcp.osc-bridge.roomi-fields.com/v1/trust.

MCP tools on your machine: list_devices (filters: query, vendor, kind, limit), get_device_docs, list_routes, send, get_status, detect_hardware, backup_presets, restore_presets (refuses without confirm_overwrite: true).

## Documentation

- [Home]({site_url}): what osc-bridge does
- [Getting started]({site_url}getting-started/): install, detect, run, send
- [Device catalogue]({site_url}catalogue/): search every driver; one page per device at {site_url}devices/<vendor>/<driver>/ with its OSC, CC and NRPN map
- [Connect your synth]({site_url}connect/): no-install relay — open in Chrome or Edge, give the pairing code to the agent; relay_status, relay_detect, relay_send, relay_listen reach the user's hardware through the hosted MCP server
- [API for agents]({site_url}api/): static JSON API — [index of every driver]({site_url}api/v1/index.json) (source tier, firmware, coverage) and each driver file at {site_url}api/v1/devices/<vendor>/<driver>.json; hosted MCP server at https://mcp.osc-bridge.roomi-fields.com/mcp (no sign-up: the server issues an account id)
- [MCP server]({site_url}MCP/): configuration and the eight tools
- [Device JSON schema]({site_url}DEVICE_JSON_SCHEMA/): CC/NRPN params, SysEx commands, drum triggers, replies, OSC transport
- [Your first device JSON]({site_url}TUTORIAL_FIRST_DEVICE/): write a driver in about 30 minutes
- [Changelog]({site_url}changelog/): every release
